import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 505;
    static int n, m, mod;
    static int[][] C = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static long[] f = new long[maxn], g = new long[maxn];
    static long[][] F = new long[maxn][maxn], G = new long[maxn][maxn];

    static int add_mod(int x, int y) {
        int res = x + y;
        if (res >= mod) res -= mod;
        return res;
    }

    static long multiply_mod(long x, long y) {
        return (x * y) % mod;
    }

    static long multiply(long x, long y) {
        return x * y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        // Compute binomial coefficients C
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = add_mod(C[i - 1][j - 1], C[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        // Initialize f and g
        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                long val1 = multiply_mod(multiply_mod(f[j - 1], f[i - j]), multiply(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                f[i] = add_mod_long(f[i], val1);
                long val2 = multiply_mod(multiply_mod(f[j - 1], g[i - j]), multiply(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                g[i] = add_mod_long(g[i], val2);
                long val3 = multiply_mod(multiply_mod(g[j - 1], f[i - j]), multiply(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                g[i] = add_mod_long(g[i], val3);
                long val4 = multiply_mod(multiply_mod(f[j - 1], f[i - j]), multiply(add_mod(C[j][2], C[i - j + 1][2]), C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                g[i] = add_mod_long(g[i], val4);
            }
        }

        // Initialize F and G
        F[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            F[i][i] = f[i];
            G[i][i] = g[i];
            int limit = Math.min(i - 1, m);
            for (int j = 0; j <= limit; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l <= j; l++) {
                    G[i][j] = add_mod_long(G[i][j], multiply_mod(multiply_mod(g[l], F[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]));
                    F[i][j] = add_mod_long(F[i][j], multiply_mod(multiply_mod(f[l], F[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]));
                    G[i][j] = add_mod_long(G[i][j], multiply_mod(multiply_mod(f[l], G[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(G[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int add_mod(int x, int y) {
        int res = x + y;
        if (res >= mod) res -= mod;
        return res;
    }

    static long add_mod_long(long x, long y) {
        long res = x + y;
        if (res >= mod) res -= mod;
        return res;
    }
}
